-- intro: Curse-Warding Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to create powerful curses.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to create powerful curses which they can cast on themselves and others. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. These curses can be either harmful or beneficial and can have various effects: deteriorating a person's body, continually resurrecting a person, weakening and disabling enemy spells, detonating a person's magic power, high speed regeneration, and many other possibilities. Some of these curses carry the additional risk of being passed on to those who talk about them; this effect can be avoided by entering a space separate from the normal world. The curses' power and effects can be cut off by defeating the user or placing the user in a space that separates them from the world.
-- spell pages: Exploding Life; Decaying World; Malevolent Femcantation; Unbound Slave
